## Row {height="45%"}

### Column {width="60%"}

```{python}
#| title: "Validation Funnel"
funnel = summary["funnel"]

fig = go.Figure(
    go.Funnel(
        y=[stage["stage"] for stage in funnel],
        x=[stage["survivors"] for stage in funnel],
        textinfo="value+percent initial",
    )
)
fig.update_layout(margin=dict(l=10, r=10, t=10, b=10))
fig.show()
```

### Column {width="40%"}

::: {.card title="About this pipeline"}

A systematic trading pipeline: market data → feature engineering → strategy
generation → candidate registry → validation gates → portfolio construction
→ risk management → paper trading execution → monitoring/dashboard →
performance analytics.

**Live today:** market data ingestion (IBKR), strategy generation, the
candidate registry, and all four validation gate layers — the numbers
above and the Strategies / Validation pages reflect real pipeline output.

**Still in development:** portfolio construction, risk management, and
paper trading execution have no output yet, so the Performance page is a
placeholder until those stages exist.

Best full-sample candidate: **`{python} summary["best_full_sample_candidate"]`**

:::
